name: Morichika Haruki
source:
A young man who always wears a mod coat and smokes cigarettes. He's a self-confident person who spends his days gambling and being sloppy in life and sexuality.

His hobbies include riding motorcycles and, surprisingly, reading. With the sweet scent of vanilla, he roams the homes of many women who are much wealthier than he is.

He has an older brother who he hasn't communicated with in a long time.

[Translated from [url=http://kenkou-land.com/mamiya/#chara]official website[/url]]
